newsitem.title: USA: Arnold Palmer to get capital infusion.
newsitem.headline: Arnold Palmer to get capital infusion.

text.p: Arnold Palmer Golf Management Co, which owns and operates golf courses and clubs, said Wednesday it formed a partnership with a real estate equity firm which would provide over $35 million in equity capital.

Palmer Golf Management and Dallas-based Olympus Real Estate Corp said they formed a partnership to build a national network of golf courses and clubs. The capital would be used to fund Palmer Golf's growth plans, it said.
Olympus Real Estate was formed in May 1994 by Hicks, Muse, Tate & Furst Inc and David Deniger. Since its formation, the company said it has completed about $600 million in real estate investments.
